decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to use equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly equip creatures and deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on using cards like Sigarda's Aid and Puresteel Paladin to cheat out and equip equipment efficiently, while also protecting your creatures with Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel. The goal is to assemble a powerful creature with multiple pieces of equipment attached, allowing you to overwhelm your opponent and win the game in just a few turns.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Indomitable Creativity, and Leyline Binding to create powerful combos and control the board. By using cards like Wrenn and Six, Persist, and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to consistently create strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and enable quick plays. Overall, the deck aims to showcase innovative and creative plays to outmaneuver opponents and secure victories.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to combo off and cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It utilizes cards like Wrenn and Six for repeatable value, and Bitter Reunion to fill the graveyard for Persist. The deck also runs interaction like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to be creative in utilizing different cards and combos to win the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of disruption and efficient creatures. By using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck aims to apply early pressure on the opponent while using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt their game plan. Feign Death and Undying Malice help to protect key creatures while also providing additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the "Hammer Time" combo by equipping Colossus Hammer to a creature such as Ornithopter or Inkmoth Nexus, allowing for massive damage to be dealt in a single swing. The deck includes various ways to fetch and equip the hammer efficiently, while also providing protection with cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce. Using Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to help cheat out equipment, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and explosive combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly put as many creatures as possible onto the battlefield using cards like Glimpse of Tomorrow, Violent Outburst, and Shardless Agent. By casting Glimpse of Tomorrow and shuffling creatures into the library, players can cheat big creatures onto the battlefield for a surprise attack. Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide extra value when creatures enter the battlefield, while Wavesifter and Chancellor of the Forge create a wide board presence. The mana base includes cards like Cavern of Souls and Khalni Garden to ensure smooth casting of spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. With access to powerful colorless spells and threats like Karn Liberated, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt opponents' strategies, and win through powerful threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Blast Zone, along with cards like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map to ensure the Tron lands come online quickly and consistently.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through disruptive cards like Blood Moon, Relic of Progenitus, and Thoughtseize while also utilizing powerful creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Bonecrusher Giant, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of big red cards like Fury and Obosh, the Preypiercer enhances the deck's aggressive potential. The deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a strong board presence to ultimately secure a victory in a Modern 1 vs 1 match.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of Elementals and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending to control the board while also ramping up with Wrenn and Six and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of creatures like Solitude and Endurance provide additional protection and removal options. The deck also benefits from the versatility of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion to further enhance its control capabilities. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Kroxa while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. It also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Malakir Rebirth and Undying Evil to keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, it includes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's mana base and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to provide a powerful late-game threat. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and finish the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and efficient creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By combining cards like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to control the game early on while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and help with deck filtering. The mana base is optimized for both consistency and flexibility, allowing for smooth gameplay and strong tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and synergies with multicolored creatures and spells. By utilizing a wide range of colors, the deck can adapt to different situations and overwhelm opponents with a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion ensures consistent access to mana acceleration, allowing the deck to maintain its pace and pressure throughout the game. With a mix of powerful creatures and versatile spells, this aggro deck aims to quickly establish board presence and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on combining the cards Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield early. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo from disruption, while cards like Wrenn and Six and Prismari Command provide additional value and control elements. The deck uses fetch lands to thin the deck and ensure the combo pieces are drawn efficiently. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to surprise the opponent with a powerful creature and control the game with a mix of creativity and strategy.

This deck revolves around the idea of using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty by sacrificing tokens created by Dwarven Mine. The deck also includes cards like Persist and Bitter Reunion to create more tokens for sacrificing. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected threats and disruption through a combination of combo pieces and removal spells. The deck's strategy relies on creativity and resource management to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on setting up a powerful combo by utilizing cards like Primeval Titan, Amulet of Vigor, and Urza's Saga to generate massive amounts of mana and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By ramping quickly with cards such as Sakura-Tribe Elder and Arboreal Grazer, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to either overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of giant creatures or deal massive amounts of damage with Valakut triggers. Utilizing lands like Cavern of Souls and Boseiju, Who Endures also helps protect the combo from disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer and Stoneforge Mystic, using equipment tutors like Steelshaper's Gift and Sigarda's Aid to find them. Puresteel Paladin and Springleaf Drum help to quickly equip Colossus Hammer onto Ornithopter or other small creatures, allowing for explosive damage output early in the game. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Inkmoth Nexus provides additional threats and utility. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with fast, unblockable, and massive damage from equipped creatures.
